readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the family's New Year's Eve dinner, when Aurèle had everyone show him their watches
At the temple's nine o'clock strike; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell
When Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case, after the piquet game in the salon
When the temple struck ten during the piquet game
During the piquet game, when the temple struck ten; Vauthier noticed it showed five minutes to ten

whereabouts: Dr Vauthier dined with the family at the Monnier house on the last day of the year, as he does every year.
Dr Vauthier and Madame Monnier sat down to piquet in the salon.
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat, while the game was still in progress.
Madame Monnier began to play the piano as Dr Vauthier went out to the hall, and stopped when he came back.
Dr Vauthier was in the salon during the piquet game when the temple struck ten.
Dr Vauthier fetched his own cigar case.
